passages.quote:
This Policy Framework ensures that our obligations under the Public Sector Equality Duty are met, in respect of our care and management of offenders and children in custody. Specifically,

working to prevent and address discrimination on the grounds of the 9 protected characteristics: Age, Disability, Gender Reassignment, Marriage & Civil Partnership Pregnancy & Maternity, Race, Religion & Belief, Sex, Sexual Orientation

actively promoting diversity and inclusion

investigating and dealing with instances of discrimination when they arise

It includes guidance on legal obligations as well as the requirement for monitoring, reporting and producing equality analysis. Full implementation is expected on 1st January 2025.
